title: Conjunctions
content:
🔤 Definition

Conjunctions wo words hote hain jo do ya zyada words, phrases, ya clauses ko jodte hain. 💫 Inhe hum joining words bhi kehte hain.

🧠 Example: I wanted to play, but it was raining.

🌈 Types of Conjunctions

  1. 🔹 Coordinating Conjunctions – Dono parts equal importance ke hote hain.
    👉 FANBOYS – For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So
    💬 Example: I wanted to go out, but it was too late.
  2. 🔸 Subordinating Conjunctions – Ek clause doosre par depend karta hai.
    👉 because, although, if, since, when, unless, while
    💬 Example: I stayed home because it was raining.
  3. 🔹 Correlative Conjunctions – Pair mein aate hain.
    👉 either...or, neither...nor, both...and, not only...but also
    💬 Example: Either you study hard or fail the test. 😅

💎 Common Examples

TypeConjunctionsExample
Coordinatingand, but, or, so, for, nor, yetI was tired, so I went to sleep.
Subordinatingbecause, although, since, unlessI didn’t go because I was sick.
Correlativeeither...or, neither...norNeither he nor I was ready.

💬 Usage Tips

  • ✅ Use comma before coordinating conjunctions in compound sentences.
  • 🧩 Subordinating conjunctions make dependent clauses.
  • ⚡ Correlative conjunctions always come in pairs — don’t separate them!
  • 💬 Try examples daily: “I will go if it stops raining.”
🎯 Example Practice:
1️⃣ I like coffee and tea.
2️⃣ She didn’t come because she was tired.
3️⃣ Not only is he smart, but also very kind.

🌟 Memory Trick

🧠 FANBOYS = For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So
🎵 Use this as a mini song in your head — it really helps!
